paper.title: Subjective Probability: A Judgment of Representativeness
paper.description: When people estimate probability, do they judge how representative an outcome looks instead of using the probability rules relevant to the problem?

review.reason: Accepted exact candidate as a concise reading-only research summary with source locators and explicit scope limits. This is not full-instrument or executable-protocol approval.
